extracted text: LiAlGeO4·H2O with the zeolite ABW topology was synthesized hydrothermally from the gel composition 1.0 Li2O:1.0 Al2O3:2 GeO2:100 H2O. 0.42 g of hydrated LiOH·H2O (Fisher Scientific) was dissolved in 8.70 g of deionized water in a 30 cm3 Teflon bottle. 1.04 g of GeO2 (Alfa) was then added to this solution and the mixture stirred at room temperature for 2 h. 0.68 g of Al2O3 (Catapal, Vista) was then added to this mixture. After being stirred for 24 h at room temperature, the resultant gel was heated for 5 days at 110°C.
